name: the-fraud
description: The Fraud - realtime multiplayer deduction game (Express + Socket.IO + React)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm -C server install && npm -C client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm -C server run dev" "npm -C client run dev"
scripts.build: npm -C client run build && npm -C server run build
scripts.lint: npm -C client run lint && npm -C server run lint
